sql: WITH mm AS (SELECT DISTINCT market_ticker, strategy FROM live_orders WHERE strategy IN ('Lmmsell10','Lmmsell8','mmsell10','mmsell10a','mmsell10b') AND action='buy'), latest AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (p.market_ticker) p.market_ticker,p.quantity,p.realized_pnl FROM positions p JOIN mm ON mm.market_ticker=p.market_ticker ORDER BY p.market_ticker,p.captured_at DESC), rows AS (SELECT mm.strategy, CASE WHEN split_part(mm.market_ticker,'-',1) ~ '(BTC|ETH|SOL|DOGE|XRP|CRYPTO)' THEN 'crypto' ELSE 'non_crypto' END AS universe,l.realized_pnl FROM latest l JOIN mm ON mm.market_ticker=l.market_ticker WHERE l.quantity=0 AND l.realized_pnl IS NOT NULL) SELECT strategy,universe,count(*) AS n,round(sum(realized_pnl)::numeric,2) AS realized_dollars,round(avg(realized_pnl)::numeric,4) AS avg_dollars,round(100.0*avg((realized_pnl>0)::int),1) AS win_pct FROM rows GROUP BY strategy,universe ORDER BY strategy,universe
